steps.prompt: A ticket costs $48$ points. Is $21$ tickets more or less than $1000$ points? How can you tell fast?

cards.title: Round, then multiply
cards.body: Round each number to one friendly number, then multiply: $48 \times 21 \approx 50 \times 20 = 1000$. The exact answer is $1008$.

steps.text: $4 \times 6 = 24$, and tens times tens makes hundreds.

cards.title: Count the zeros
cards.body: $40 \times 60$: multiply $4 \times 6 = 24$, then add the two zeros: $2400$. Counting zeros is where most estimates go wrong: check the size makes sense.

prompts: Why is it easy to lose or gain a zero when estimating products? How do you check?
